title: Canonical adjacent-suffix slack and post-jump producer specialisation

concepts.label: canonical adjacent-suffix central slack
concepts.note: The minimum two-sided margin from the canonical residue to the central-band edges.

concepts.label: post-jump slack supply
concepts.note: Cofinal strict LCM jumps whose new endpoint has nonnegative slack.

concepts.label: power-two post-jump slack supply
concepts.note: The specialization of the same sign condition to endpoints 2^a.

concepts.label: narrow replacement boundary
concepts.note: Z05 retains the broader centrality ladder, transports, and irrationality consumers.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Let m=canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth(t) and d=diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue(t,0,m). Then canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack(t)=min(d-2^(m-5),(2^m-2^(m-5))-d). Nonnegativity is exactly the closed central band 2^(m-5)≤d≤2^m-2^(m-5), and the scalar is constant across equal periodLcm heights.
statement_nodes.engine: exact slack definition, centrality iff, and plateau invariance from the existing Z05 theorem substrate
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-specific LCM-jump coordinate; no external novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The scalar definition proves no recurrence, monotonicity, equidistribution, or sign bias. Plateau invariance does not propagate slack across a strict jump.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply asks that beyond every threshold there be a strict LCM jump periodLcm(t)<periodLcm(t+1) whose new endpoint has 0≤canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack(t+1).
statement_nodes.engine: exact cofinal post-jump producer definition and existing Z05 consumer chain
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-specific sufficient supply predicate; no external novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Strict LCM jumps are cofinal, but the slack sign at those jumps is unproved. The predicate evaluates at t+1, not t; finite censuses cannot discharge the cofinal quantifier.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply asks that for arbitrarily large exponents a≥2, 0≤canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack(2^a). The corresponding pre-jump index is 2^a-1, while slack is evaluated at the new endpoint 2^a.
statement_nodes.engine: exact power-two cofinal producer definition and the proved strict-jump reindexing transport
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Corpus-specific sufficient supply predicate; no external novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Power-two indices remove the position search but do not prove nonnegative slack. Only the forward implication to general post-jump supply is proved; no converse or necessity for irrationality is available.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The supply is exactly a cofinal nonnegativity condition on this scalar immediately after strict LCM jumps.
The power-two producer restricts the same scalar sign condition to endpoints 2^a.
canonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply_of_powerTwo uses periodLcm(2^a-1)<periodLcm(2^a) and reindexes each power-of-two witness as a post-jump witness.
